# CodePipeline execution and release automation

**Status: future extensions.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Durable executions, supported AWS actions, approvals, retry and stage transitions are implemented; release automation extensions remain.

## Proposed scope

- [x] Start/Get/List/Stop pipeline executions
- [x] Stage transitions and failed-stage retry
- [x] Manual approval results and action execution history
- [x] CodeCommit source changes and AWS action providers
- [ ] S3 change detection, V2 connection triggers and stage conditions
- [ ] Rollback, webhooks, custom jobs and retained pipeline versions

## Integration decisions

Executions persist in the shared store and invoke local services outside transactions. CodeBuild execution requires codebuild.builds: docker.
